The '''Torize system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Torize]], and was situated on the [[Trition Trade Route]]. It was connected to the [[Kolatill system/Legends|Kolatill]], [[Oon Tien system/Legends|Oon Tien]], and [[Brolsam system/Legends|Brolsam systems]] via [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]].<ref name="tdc" />
